normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the deeded beach access or take the complimentary tram- 3500 sq. foot home- one of the largest homes in the Seacrest community!- Outdoor Griddle- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day- Privacy fence surrounding pool added in 2024- Access to Seacrest's 12,000-square-foot community pool and multiple community parks (including one directly across the street)- 4 adult bikes provided- SONOS sound system- New home built in 2022- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutPlease note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: Poolside Paradise is a spacious, brand-new 4-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Seacrest Beach home steps from Scenic 30A. A short stroll from Rosemary and Alys beaches to local restaurants, boutiques, and even an ice cream/toy shop, this family-friendly area offers plenty of entertainment. Guests will love the quick walk to the beach, private pool, 4 adult bikes, and dedicated parking for 3 vehicles. This property sleeps 14.Enjoy entertaining friends and family in this chic, 3-story home with an open layout, vaulted ceilings, stunning natural light, and gleaming wood floors. Relax in the airy, white living room on the cozy linen couch or 2 armchairs while binge-watching your favorite TV shows or listening to your favorite music on the built-in Sonos sound system. Whip up delicious dinners for your guests in the gourmet kitchen equipped with Upscale appliances, quartz countertops, and a 4-stool breakfast bar at the large island. Gather around the 8-seat dining table for supper before heading outside to the back porch for fun in the private pool. Turf areas adjacent to the pool are a perfect place for the kids to play. Guests can stow wet beach gear in the large mudroom which includes a full-sized washer and dryer. A guest bedroom with an ensuite bathroom is down the hall.The second floor features 3 bedrooms, access to a front balcony, and an office area with a large desk. The primary bedroom includes a private soaking tub and access to the rear balcony while the bunk room offers queen-over-queen beds for guests. There’s also another laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer and plenty of counter space for added convenience.A family-friendly oasis on the third floor includes a cozy living room with a 12-game arcade machine with PAC-MAN, Galaga, Dig Dug, and more. The 75” TV with Sonos surround sound is perfect for watching the big game or movie night. The kitchenette includes a beverage refrigerator, a large built-in ice maker, and a dishwasher. Step onto the front deck for outstanding community views and beautiful sunsets.Poolside Paradise offers a luxurious and fun beach vacation. Guests will love the private pool, access to the largest community pool on 30A, and 4 adult bikes. Book Poolside Paradise today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyBunk Room: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:Additional Living Space: Lounge Area, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seacrest Beach "Poolside Paradise" 370 Beach Bike Way Seacrest Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-116098 Bedrooms 4 Beds 7 Sleeps 14 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short walk to the deeded beach access or take the complimentary tram - 3500 sq. foot home- one of the largest homes in the Seacrest community! - Outdoor Griddle - Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day - Privacy fence surrounding pool added in 2024 - Access to Seacrest's 12,000-square-foot community pool and multiple community parks (including one directly across the street) - 4 adult bikes provided - SONOS sound system - New home built in 2022 - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Please note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities. DETAILS: Poolside Paradise is a spacious, brand-new 4-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Seacrest Beach home steps from Scenic 30A. A short stroll from Rosemary and Alys beaches to local restaurants, boutiques, and even an ice cream/toy shop, this family-friendly area offers plenty of entertainment. Guests will love the quick walk to the beach, private pool, 4 adult bikes, and dedicated parking for 3 vehicles. This property sleeps 14. Enjoy entertaining friends and family in this chic, 3-story home with an open layout, vaulted ceilings, stunning natural light, and gleaming wood floors. Relax in the airy, white living room on the cozy linen couch or 2 armchairs while binge-watching your favorite TV shows or listening to your favorite music on the built-in Sonos sound system. Whip up delicious dinners for your guests in the gourmet kitchen equipped with Upscale appliances, quartz countertops, and a 4-stool breakfast bar at the large island. Gather around the 8-seat dining table for supper before heading outside to the back porch for fun in the private pool. Turf areas adjacent to the pool are a perfect place for the kids to play. Guests can stow wet beach gear in the large mudroom which includes a full-sized washer and dryer. A guest bedroom with an ensuite bathroom is down the hall. The second floor features 3 bedrooms, access to a front balcony, and an office area with a large desk. The primary bedroom includes a private soaking tub and access to the rear balcony while the bunk room offers queen-over-queen beds for guests. There’s also another laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer and plenty of counter space for added convenience. A family-friendly oasis on the third floor includes a cozy living room with a 12-game arcade machine with PAC-MAN, Galaga, Dig Dug, and more. The 75” TV with Sonos surround sound is perfect for watching the big game or movie night. The kitchenette includes a beverage refrigerator, a large built-in ice maker, and a dishwasher. Step onto the front deck for outstanding community views and beautiful sunsets. Poolside Paradise offers a luxurious and fun beach vacation. Guests will love the private pool, access to the largest community pool on 30A, and 4 adult bikes. Book Poolside Paradise today!
